constraints.name: equal_set_sizes
constraints.description: The number of students equals the number of pseudonyms, both are exactly n, ensuring a perfect matching is possible.

constraints.name: bijective_matching
constraints.description: The assignment must be a one-to-one correspondence: each student receives exactly one pseudonym and each pseudonym is assigned to exactly one student.
constraints.formal: π : S → P is a bijection

constraints.name: maximize_sum_lcp
constraints.description: The quality of a matching is the sum of longest common prefix lengths between matched pairs. The goal is to maximize this total sum.
